create_mpnet_model: create an MPNetModel to extract sequence and pooled embeddings from input token IDs
build_masked_lm: build an MPNetForMaskedLM model to predict masked tokens in a sequence
train_sequence_classifier: train an MPNetForSequenceClassification model for GLUE-style classification tasks
run_question_answering: run an MPNetForQuestionAnswering model to predict start and end token positions
classify_tokens: classify tokens with MPNetForTokenClassification for NER or similar sequence labeling tasks
